This page navigates the repository's governance and technical corpus, which
lives on this site as the articles listed below (converted from the former
`docs/` tree; a handful of cross-references in older records still cite the
historical paths). It links, never copies: the roster is re-derived from the
repository bytes by the governing test, so an article added or renamed
without a bridge row reddens the suite.

For the user-facing learning path (install, first analysis, and the task
guides), start at [Get started](get-started.html) and the [tour](tour.html).
